summary.qualitative: Merchant traffic in the separation lanes is essentially absent across all four images: no large vessels (>=150 m) were seen in any image, and only two medium-or-smaller vessels were seen in total, both under way. The only notable activity is a group of roughly a dozen small fast craft with wakes on 2026-07-21. There are no anchorages, queues or stationary large ships.
